mentions.name: DevRoulette
mentions.description: This app pairs a developer working on a task in Claude Code with a random developer who is also waiting on theirs, letting them chat, skip, or end the conversation at any time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
working on DevRoulette

You start a task in Claude Code, and it automatically matches you with a random dev who’s also waiting on theirs.

You can chat, skip, or end the chat anytime.

http://github.com/DevRoulette
